With cards such as Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
or Vamp i.e Wynn that allows to directly attack a
vampire, does the vampire have to be untapped in
order to be attacked in this fashion? Can the

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> With cards such as Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
> or Vamp i.e Wynn that allows to directly attack a
> vampire, does the vampire have to be untapped in
> order to be attacked in this fashion?

No.

> Can the vamp be attacked while he/she is tapped?

Yes. As a matter of fact, Ambush (the Sabbat equivilant
of Bum's Rush) stipulates that the attacked vampire must
be tapped.

Sorrow

Messages.Body:

> vampire, does the vampire have to be untapped in

> order to be attacked in this fashion? Can the

No.

> vamp be attacked while he/she is tapped?

Yes.

And note: being tapped has no effect on the ability of
the vampire to fight. He can maneuver, strike, press,
prevent, etc. equally well tapped or not.
